batch_objective: Close the blockers preventing a safe full 20-tile retry
headline: The 5711 building-reference failure is now PROVEN and my earlier hypothesis is REFUTED. It is not a mount-point or junction problem: all 5711 meshes exist on disk with correct tile-prefixed names, but in /Game/Ingolstadt/Static/Terrain/Ingolstadt while the tile map serializes references to /Game/Ingolstadt/Maps/Ingolstadt. The package root is identical; the reference simply omits the 'Static/Terrain' segment.

proof.interpretation: Object naming and asset creation are both correct. Only the package sub-path is wrong.

hypothesis_refuted.reason: /Game/Ingolstadt is a REAL directory, not a junction. The five junctions (Carla/Maps->Maps, Carla/Static->Static, Carla/Blueprints, Carla/Config, Carla/HDMaps) are real but do not participate in this failure.

decisive_filesystem_evidence.map_folder: /Game/Ingolstadt/Maps/Ingolstadt contains Ingolstadt.umap, MAT_*.uasset, OpenDrive/, TM/ and ZERO building meshes
decisive_filesystem_evidence.conclusion: The buildings were imported through the props channel, not the map channel that the references assume.

producer_evidence.note: DestinationPath is the literal template '/Game/package/...'. CARLA substitutes PackageName at commandlet runtime, giving /Game/Ingolstadt/Maps/Ingolstadt, which matches the serialized reference exactly. So the import DESTINATION was correct; the meshes simply are not there.

candidate_fixes.action: Import the tile FBX meshes into the map destination /Game/Ingolstadt/Maps/Ingolstadt so meshes sit beside the .umap, matching CARLA's stock Town01 layout.
candidate_fixes.risk: Changes the asset namespace; requires re-import and re-cook.

candidate_fixes.action: Rewrite the map's serialized references to /Game/Ingolstadt/Static/Terrain/Ingolstadt/<Name>.
candidate_fixes.risk: Requires editing serialized .umap or the reference producer; diverges from CARLA's stock layout.

junction_audit.removal: NOT_REMOVED - no tested replacement exists; removing them would break editor initialization

Map:/Game/Carla/Maps/BaseLargeMap/LargeM.root_cause: SAME PHYSICAL MAP REACHABLE THROUGH TWO /Game PATHS
Map:/Game/Carla/Maps/BaseLargeMap/LargeM.mechanism: /Game/Carla/Maps is a junction to /Game/Maps, so /Game/Carla/Maps/BaseLargeMap/LargeMap and /Game/Maps/BaseLargeMap/LargeMap are the same file. UE4 Map PrimaryAssetID is Map:<AssetName>, which ignores path, so the alias produces a duplicate ID.

Map:/Game/Carla/Maps/TestMaps/EmptyMap.root_cause: MANY DISTINCT TILE PACKAGES RESOLVING TO ONE PRIMARY ASSET NAME
Map:/Game/Carla/Maps/TestMaps/EmptyMap.mechanism: Multiple /Game/Maps/Town11/Town11_Tile_* packages contain a map whose primary asset name is EmptyMap, so all of them collide with the EmptyMap identity.

primary_asset_id.reason_not_closed: Fixing these requires either editing CARLA's AssetManager scan configuration or removing the junctions. Both need a tested replacement, which this batch did not build.

capabilities: classify_exit_status: 0xC000013A/0xC000003A -> EXTERNALLY_INTERRUPTED, explicitly not CRASH and not SUCCESS
detect_process_role: distinguishes UE4Editor.exe -run= (COMMANDLET) from plain UE4Editor.exe (INTERACTIVE_EDITOR), so the interactive editor can never be used as import evidence
ImportState: atomic writes, validated transitions, full history, terminal states have no outgoing edges so a stale RUNNING state cannot occur
run_supervised: writes COMMANDLET_EXECUTION_RECEIPT.json on every path including KeyboardInterrupt
StorageGate: fails closed on unmeasurable volumes and invents no thresholds
process_supervision.stale_prevention_mechanism: INTERRUPTED and CHILD_FAILED are terminal in the transition table; any further transition raises IllegalTransition

ctrl_c_handling.wrapper_behaviour_defined: On interruption the wrapper records INTERRUPTED, stops launching further tile jobs, writes a receipt, and returns nonzero. It never kills unrelated interactive UE4Editor sessions because role detection separates them.

storage.gate_behaviour: Fails closed on unmeasurable volumes and refuses to invent thresholds; the caller must supply MIN_FREE_*_GB derived from measured prior output.
storage.blocker: Deriving honest thresholds needs measured peak usage from a successful run, which does not yet exist.

distance_field.not_attempted_reason: Requires per-mesh forensics across all 27 stalls plus 27 controls, which needs the extended mesh metrics and a full import telemetry run. Not started in this batch.
distance_field.hypothesis_not_claimed: The log's own 'rebuilt excessively' hint is a suggestion, not evidence. No StaticMesh rebuild count has been measured, so rebuild excess remains neither proven nor ruled out.

bugs_found_by_the_new_tests: carla_import_supervision kept two lists of NTSTATUS codes and they drifted: DLL_NOT_FOUND, ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND and DLL_INIT_FAILED were documented as faults but not classified as crashes. Fixed by deriving CRASH_STATUSES from NTSTATUS so there is one source of truth.
